reactor_type: hot-wall flow-type ALD reactor (SUNALE TM R75, Picosun, Finland)
evidence: Using a commercial hot-wall flow-type ALD reactor (SUNALE TM R75, Picosun, Finland) operated with N 2 as a precursor carrier and purge gas at a pressure of 10 Pa, 200 cycles of ZnO deposition corresponding to a nominal layer thickness of 30 nm were carried out at 60 8C with Zn(C 2H5)2 and deionized water as precursors. Pulse and purge times of 0.2 s and 5 s were applied for Zn(C 2H5)2, and of 2 s and 5 s for H 2O, respectively.
